title: Customer signal weighting & SLA-aware model onboarding playbook
creator: Aisha Kline
description: Create a repeatable playbook and intake scoring template that combines customer signals (security, SLA needs, usage volume, regulatory constraints) with product SLAs to prioritize model catalog onboarding, version pin requests, and deprecation schedules for enterprise customers. Deliverable: a documented rubric, example scoring sheet, decision thresholds for fast-path sandbox vs. standard onboarding, eval gate checklist per SLA tier, and roll-forward runbook for emergency pin requests.
acceptance_criteria: Rubric doc published in Confluence with signal definitions and weightings
Scoring spreadsheet template available and linked in catalog intake form
Three example customer requests scored and triaged using the rubric (internal exercise)
Eval gate checklist created for SLA tiers (Gold/Silver/Bronze) and integrated into onboarding flow
Owners identified for fast-path, standard, and enterprise lanes and on-call escalation for pin/deprecations
proposed_solution: Define signal categories: security/compliance, production usage, latency/cost sensitivity, regulatory region, strategic relationship, incident history, and model QA score
Assign base weights: security=30, SLA requirements=25, production volume=20, model QA=15, business strategic=10 (weights adjustable by PM consensus)
Establish thresholds: score >= 75 -> Fast-path with canary and 24h visibility; score 50-74 -> Standard onboarding with 1-week shadow; score < 50 -> Sandbox/manual review
SLA-aware eval gates: Gold tier requires static eval set pass rate >= 98% for key prompts, Bronze may accept 95% with rollback policy
Auto-pin policy: customers with Gold SLA get ability to request pin for a minor patch; deprecation notifications follow 90/60/30 day cadence depending on risk tier
rollout_plan: Week 1: Draft rubric + workshop with Solutions Eng and Security to validate weights
Week 2: Implement scoring sheet and add fields to intake form (Confluence form -> intake pipeline)
Week 3: Run 10 retrospective customer requests through rubric and adjust weights
Week 4: Integrate eval gate checklist into onboarding runbook and publish to internal docs
Week 5: Pilot with two enterprise customers for auto-pin and deprecation notifications
metrics_and_dashboards: % of requests routed to fast-path / standard / sandbox (target fast-path <= 20% initially)
Time from intake to onboarding completion by lane (target median fast-path < 3 days)
Number of post-onboard regressions detected by quality monitoring in first 14 days
Customer satisfaction score for onboarding (NPS follow-up)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overweighting strategic customers could reduce objective quality thresholds -> Mitigation: cap strategic weight at 10% and require QA gate pass for all pins
Risk: False negatives for compliance-sensitive requests -> Mitigation: security triage override with SLA to escalate within 24h
Risk: Operational overhead for manual scoring -> Mitigation: prototype automated pre-fill using usage telemetry and customer profile
